  Description: "Located in the hidden valley in the western foothills of The Misty Mountains, Rivendell endures under the protection of Elrond and the Elven ring that he possesses. The power of Vilya has kept Rivendell safe, and made it a place of peace and refuge to all of the Free Peoples of Middle-earth, earning it the name 'The Last Homely House'.\n\nHowever, even places such as Rivendell need protection from the ever-growing Evil in the Third Age. Under Lord Elrond's orders, Elven captains patrol Rivendell's borders, making sure that they are kept free from foul creatures that would bring destruction upon them. Although rare, it has been known for the Elven patrols from Rivendell to venture further beyond their borders, offering aid to those in need against the forces of Sauron."
